_title: FS Code 2011 (2024 Ed.) Part E - reaction-to-fire classes, lining requirements and deemed-to-satisfy FRR tables E2-E7
_columns: values listed for FRR [240, 120, 60] minutes; null = not given for that FRR

wall_brick_solid.note: 120 min may be 100 mm with 13 mm gypsum plaster each side

wall_clay_hollow_block.note: 2 cells ≥ 50% solid, 13 mm gypsum plaster each side

wall_concrete_hollow_block.note: one cell ≥ 50% solid, 13 mm gypsum plaster each side

_star_note: Covers marked * in the Code (e.g. 240-min floors, 120/240-min simply supported beams) need supplementary mesh/lath within 20 mm of the face.

test_standards.loadbearing: BS EN 1363-1, BS EN 1365-1 to -6 (classified to BS EN 13501-2); BS 476-20/21 until obsolete
test_standards.non_loadbearing_walls: BS EN 1364-1; ceilings BS EN 1364-2; raised floors BS EN 1366-6
test_standards.doors_shutters_windows: BS EN 1634-1/-2/-3, BS EN 14600 (insulation I1 recommended); BS 476-22 until obsolete; tag/label every fire door
test_standards.penetration_seals: BS EN 1366-3, joint seals BS EN 1366-4 (integrity only)
test_standards.dampers: BS EN 1366-2, BS ISO 10294-1/2/3/5; certified by registered specialist contractor (ventilation works)
test_standards.smoke_seal_doors: BS EN 1634-3, BS EN 14600, ISO 5925-1, UL 1784 or AS 1530.7 (ambient and medium temperature)
test_standards.linings: BS EN ISO 1182, 1716, BS EN 13823, BS EN ISO 11925-2; BS 476-4/6/7 until obsolete
test_standards.laboratories: HOKLAS-accredited (or MRA partner) laboratory test report, or HKCAS-accredited certification body assessment, within accredited scope
